title: Starting Gate Voices
eyebrow: BadCode Shorts · The Starting Gate · voices round 1
heading: The Starting Gate: the commentator
intro: Five race callers designed in Google AI Studio from a sealed writer's research on real British race calling (crisp and controlled, building to the finish; never shouting from the start). Each plays the whole call, all four lines. My pick is a, from the writer's ranking: I can't hear them, so overrule it.

sections.lede: Every take checked word by word.

groups.title: BadCode, the race caller
groups.line: New money's been printed, the gates are open... and they're off! / Shares flies out! Houses right on its tail! And Wages... Wages hasn't left the stalls. / Houses home in seven years! And Wages is away! Eleven years... and nine months. / Next race. One gate. Everybody out at once.

opts.label: a: Lambourn, Berkshire, mid-fifties, crisp (my pick)
b: Malton, North Yorkshire, early sixties, warm baritone
opts.warn: Line 3: Whisper hears "The house is home" on the best of three takes: check the start by ear

opts.label: c: Newmarket, Suffolk, late sixties, dry and precise
d: Liverpool, early forties, bright and quick
e: Ayr, Scotland, late forties, firm and even
